rachel_sales: Urgent POC note — FinServ customer uploads extracted pages as base64 blobs inside JSON. One file ballooned to ~120MB and got a 413 at our edge. Demo in 4h. Any quick unblock? :grimace:

liu_infra: 413 = gateway rejecting body. Base64 increases size ~33% vs binary. If they can send raw files to S3 and send references, that's ideal.

max_dev: Alternate quick fixes: 1) Client-side multipart upload (presign) to S3, 2) Send only text (not base64) in chunks, 3) Use multipart/form-data to stream files if their client supports it.

rachel_sales: They want minimal code changes. Can you give a tiny javascript snippet to presign+upload parts then POST references?

max_dev: Sure — minimal flow: backend issues presigned URLs, client PUTs object(s), then POST to /v1/documents with an array of urls. Example (pseudo):

```
// client: upload file to presigned url
fetch(presign.url, { method: 'PUT', body: file })
// then notify server/api
fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/documents', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN' }, body: JSON.stringify({ files: [presign.url] }) })
```

liu_infra: Also mention they can gzip text before base64 to reduce size, but best is avoid base64 in JSON.

ops_anna: Policy blurb for security questionnaire: "Request payloads are processed transiently; persistent storage of document content is opt-in. For POCs we recommend customer-owned object storage (presigned uploads) to avoid sending large payloads through our gateway."

rachel_sales: Cost question: will chunking cause extra charges?

max_dev: Embedding cost is per token processed. If you chunk with small overlaps you incur extra tokens; estimate +5-25% depending on overlap. Offer: we can provide a small POC credit if they need to run many chunks.

liu_infra: If they insist on single-request ingestion for compliance reasons, propose Redwood Private/VPC — gateway limits are configurable there. Note: Private onboarding takes weeks and involves procurement.

infra-bot: note: rolling deploy tonight 03:30 UTC — no gateway config changes allowed until after window.

rachel_sales: Good. I'll send the presign snippet and security line. If they still see 413 after switching to presigned URLs, we'll capture curl and nginx access logs and escalate to eng-runtime.
